changes.title: Seven focused workspaces
changes.detail: Keyboard, Typing & intelligence, Interactions, Voice, Tools, Privacy and Manage consolidate navigation, search breadcrumbs and existing preference ownership; legacy routes retained.

changes.title: Glass Studio and geometry
changes.detail: Dedicated Surface, Keys and Accent editor with separate light/dark drafts, transient renderer preview and Apply/Cancel; direct geometry schematic and exact values.

changes.title: Simpler controls without changing the typing engine
changes.detail: Correction and suggestion presets, gesture assignments, feedback modes, clipboard retention presets, ordered toolbar preview, on-device voice test and explicit inherited app-profile choices. Existing permissions and protected routes retained.

changes.title: Management and regression coverage
changes.detail: Separate backup, reset, compatibility, version history and troubleshooting; preserve safe crash report and add preset tests and settings source checks.

changes.title: Keep the brand regression contract
changes.detail: Use the explicit untinted logo argument for Manage brrBoard.
